result.finding: Layered Monolith with MVC Pattern — single Spring Boot deployable unit with clear separation into Controller, Service, Repository, and Model layers, using Thymeleaf server-side rendering
evidence: Single @SpringBootApplication entry point (PhotoAlbumApplication.java) — one deployable JAR
Clear package-level layer separation: com.photoalbum.controller, com.photoalbum.service, com.photoalbum.repository, com.photoalbum.model
MVC: 3 @Controller classes + Thymeleaf templates in src/main/resources/templates + JPA entities in model package
Service layer abstraction: PhotoService interface + PhotoServiceImpl implementation
No Eureka/Consul service discovery, no API Gateway, no Kafka/RabbitMQ message brokers
docker-compose.yml has only 2 services: the app and its database (not microservices)
